items.context: @MartiniGuyYT (699.515 seguidores): "Bitcoin may be in a bear market but we've seen this playbook before" (con imagen). Post de ~20 min con 24 likes, 3 reposts, 5 respuestas y 3870 vistas, creciendo.
items.suggested_text:
The playbook rhymes, but the chapters keep changing length. In 2011 the drawdown was -92.7% and it took 622 days to get back to the old high. After the 2013 peak it was -84.5%, and recovery took 1,177 days, almost twice as long with a shallower fall.

That's the part people tend to skip when they say "we've seen this before." Depth and duration don't move together, and the pain of a bear market usually comes more from the calendar than from the percentage. I mapped every cycle's drawdown and recovery time here: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122375393776951738

So the real question is less how far $BTC falls this time and more how long the market is willing to wait.
